title: db.instance.update — converge an instance's container to the spec: recreated on the same volume (60 s clean shutdown) when its spec or image changed, else only started if stopped

version.description: the image's major version (postgres 15–18, mysql 8.0 / 8.4, mariadb 10.11 / 11.4, redis 7.4 / 8, valkey 8.1)

digest.description: pin: pulled as <repository>@<digest> and checked against the image's RepoDigests. Without it the tag is pulled again on every create/update and a newer image recreates the container (minor upgrades). Cosign signatures are not verified yet.

volume_id.description: the sized volume holding data/ and spool/ (/var/lib/falak/volumes/<id>; the agent waits up to 120 s for it to be mounted)

host_port.description: published on 127.0.0.1 (native sites on the server) and publish.addresses; absent: not published (a retired instance)

memory_bytes.description: the container's memory limit; falak-db tunes the engine to it

settings.description: falak-db settings (docs/DB_IMAGES.md), FALAK_DB_SETTINGS. Without an installed certificate the agent sets tls: false.

network.description: the environment's network, created when missing; the container joins it under aliases

aliases.description: DNS names on the network (default [falak-db-<id>]); after a major upgrade the new instance keeps the old one's name

addresses.description: private addresses (RFC 1918, CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10: WireGuard) the port is also published on; any other address fails the command

public.description: publish on every address (0.0.0.0); the control plane sends settings.require_tls with it

tls.description: db.instance.create only: the certificate from the Falak CA, written to /etc/falak/db/<id>/tls (root, 0600) and mounted read-only at /run/falak/db/tls. Updates keep the installed one.

password.description: secret: the superuser's (postgres) / root's (mysql, mariadb) / default user's (redis, valkey) password, written to /run/falak/secrets/falak-db-<id>/password (tmpfs) and given to the container as a *_FILE variable

image_digest.description: the digest the container runs (record it to pin)
